received_works.body:
Hi, I like your work very much! So I would like to request an illustration of my original character. In the link you will find detailed image references and character descriptions, and I would like you to look at the settings and create your own.

They are lovers, so I would like an illustration of them touching each other if possible. If possible, I would like you to draw some daily life-like images as well, or I would like to see them playing at an amusement park or having fun together.

I really like the cartoons you draw and would like you to draw this same type of work: https://skeb.jp/@rei_eichi_/works/14
If the request is not worth the amount or is otherwise incomplete, please feel free to request a resend. We will do our best to accommodate you.
If you still find it difficult, you can cancel your request.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1M2qAvVMDMmW6BiuFqR9zHVJaNIVU3DiI

ともなが⁵様 
こんにちは、ともなが⁵様の絵がとても魅力と思います。 
この度スケブ再開頂きありがとうございます！

良ければこちらのオリジナルBL CP二人のやり取りを描いていただきたいです。  

・キャラクター二人ともホスト。 
・二人ともタバコを吸わない。  

◆東崎（とうざき） 20歳、181cm、金髪。攻め。 
不機嫌な顔だけど優しい性格、ほどんど笑ってない。  
-当店のNo.1ホスト 
-以前、ある事件で彌緋に助けられたため、その後彌緋のことを憧れていて、とても気になるようになった。 
-言葉より行動派 
-一人称は「僕」 
-彌緋を「彌緋先輩」と呼んでいる。  

◆彌緋（びひ） 21歳、177cm、茶色髪、前髪と後ろの内とポニテールに赤いメッシュがある。受け。 
いつもチャラな言葉を使ってるけど、内心は繊細です。  
-当店のNo.3ホスト 
-以前東崎のこと後輩しか思ってませんが、最近段々気になってる。 
-一人称は「僕」だけど、偶に「俺」も使ってる 
-東崎を「東崎」と呼んでいる。  

◆二人の関係：曖昧な関係  
いつもホストグラブの2枚看板で色んなボディータッチがあるけど、最近彌緋が胸の中に何か変と思ってる。  
ずっとエレガントな先輩として、彌緋が東崎にそういう焦る姿を見せたくない。 
内心が恥ずかしくなって、目が合わないの回数が増える。  
———————————— 

URL内に二人のやり取りや漫画など参考図がございます。  ご検討のほどよろしくお願い致します。
ここまで読んで頂きありがとうございます！

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-EkIfeOfbFvoyS8a7NWbh9W4FvwDDvS7

Nice to meet you, Mr. Practice, and hello! Thank you for reopening the call for requests! I love your drawings, so please let me make a request!

If you don't mind, I would like to ask you to draw my original characters. The characters are a twin brother and sister. The older brother is a gentle boy, but a bit cool in front of others. The older brother only shows his kind side in front of his younger sister. The younger sister is a sweet and gentle girl who loves to laugh.

I don't know if this will help you, but we both like to read books!

What I would like is a warm interaction between the twins in their daily life. For example, the older brother reading a book while the younger sister makes tea! You don't have to use this composition at all! I'll leave it up to you to decide on the character's costume, the mood of the picture, the pose, etc. based on your impression of the character!

Click here for character references:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17m_ppcjHI657WqDTtWtUlA4xEWRuowQi

I hope you'll consider us! Best regards!

Dear Mr. Practice, it is nice to meet you. I have seen your wonderful illustrations and I think you will be very interested in them. I would like to ask you to illustrate a TRPG character for me and my friend.

Hello again! 

Can you please draw a comic of these two boys? It goes like this:
James (the one with light hair, he is the taller one) is opening a ring box to propose to Yazad (the one with black hair, he is shorter than James), Yazad is sitting on a bed wearing a nightgown (you can find examples of his nightgowns in the folder).
Yazad offers his hand and James puts the ring on Yazad's thumb instead of his ring finger.
Yazad looks down at his thumb, which is the wrong finger for an engagement ring, but then he blushes and smiles. It does not matter to him which finger the ring is on, he is happy and so is James~

What the ring looks like:
